caption:
The words you repeat to yourself don’t just influence your thoughts —
they affect your body.

Neuroscience shows that self-talk activates brain systems tied to stress, emotional control, and immune function. Repeated negative language keeps cortisol high, fuels inflammation, and reinforces anxiety.

Intentional, supportive language does the opposite.
It strengthens neural circuits linked to resilience, motivation, and recovery.

This is why affirmations aren’t “toxic positivity.”
They’re neural training.

Speak to yourself as if your nervous system is listening —
because it is.

Your words can quietly sabotage your life.
Or they can help rewire it.

Choose carefully.
Yang Mun
